name: Song of Days Past
description:
After your character receives healing from a source other than an Artifact: This card gains 1 stack of Yearning (max 4). At the start of the Round, for every 2 stacks of Yearning, heal the attached character for 1 HP. If this card has 4 stacks of Yearning, it heals for 1 additional HP, and DMG dealt by the equipping character is increased by 1.
(A character can equip a maximum of 1 Artifact)

storytext:
"And when we finally enjoy the embrace of the Queen of All Waters once more, we shall take leave of trouble and sorrow"
